title: DOE intelligence director never briefed on nuclear-site UAP incursions

tellings.quote:
Well, I can I can say completely openly
and transparently when I was in DOE and
I was director of intelligence,
I never was briefed on any of that.

plain: Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, a former CIA officer who says he was director of intelligence at the Department of Energy, the US department that oversees nuclear sites, from 2005 to 2008, speaks on Jesse Michels' podcast in 2026. He says openly that in that job he was never briefed on unidentified objects, which the government calls UAP, entering nuclear sites, which would matter because such visits are often claimed by others.
